user_prompt: Use $modal-sandbox to start a reusable Modal Sandbox for iterative coding.

recovery_guidance.remote_nonzero: Keep the sandbox only when further debugging was requested.
recovery_guidance.timeout: Inspect the reusable sandbox by name before deciding whether to retry.
recovery_guidance.cleanup_failure: Report the sandbox name and exact stop command.

plugin_plan.resource_boundary: Live Modal commands and destructive cleanup require explicit user approval.
